sections.title: Clothes words
sections.content: This unit is about what people wear. You know *ing*, *póló*, *nadrág*, *kabát* and *cipő*; here are five more: *szoknya* (skirt), *ruha* (dress), *sapka* (hat), *pulóver* (jumper) and *zokni* (sock). You know *Ez egy …* (near), *Az egy …* (farther away) and *Mi ez?*, the singular after a number (*két zokni*) and the plural *-k*. They work for the new words too (a final *-a* lengthens first).

items.english: What is this? This is a skirt.

sections.content: Do not use both a number and *-k*: *két zokni*, never *két zoknik*. *Pulóver* ends in a consonant and takes the linking vowel *-e-*: *pulóverek*.
